policy_name: ACKO Health III Platinum Super Top-up
specific_diseases_listed: Cataract, Glaucoma, disorders of lens, disorders of retina
Pancreatitis and stones in biliary and urinary system
Female genital prolapse, endometriosis/adenomyosis, fibroids, PCOD, hysterectomy
All benign or in situ neoplasms/tumors, cyst, sinus, polyp, nodules, swelling, mass or lump
Hyperplasia of prostate, hydrocele, varicocele, spermatocele
Hemorrhoids, fissure/fistula/abscess of anal/rectal region, pilonidal sinus, rectal prolapse
Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, intervertebral disc disorders, joint replacement
Middle ear & mastoid disease, tonsils & adenoids, nasal septum, nasal sinuses/polyp
Gastritis, GERD, ulcer, erosion, varices of upper GI tract

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: In-patient hospitalization after deductible is exhausted; aggregate deductible per Schedule

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All listed day-care procedures per Acko list

ambulance_cover.notes: Reasonable road ambulance / public transport up to SI

modern_treatments.notes: 12 listed modern treatments including HIFU, robotic surgery, stem cell BMT

room_rent_capping: No cap (actual room rent and ICU charges)
deductible_notes: This is a super top-up product. Aggregate / individual deductible applies per Schedule; insurer pays only above deductible. Specific value mentioned in policy schedule (not in wording).

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment outside India excluded unless Worldwide IP cover specified

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless WW IP cover)
Spinal subluxation adjustment, muscle stimulation (except for specific fractures)
notable_exclusions_summary: Super top-up that kicks in above aggregate deductible. Excludes treatment outside India unless WW IP cover, OPD unless add-on, maternity except ectopic, sleep disorders, STDs except HIV.
available_riders: Reduction in Specific Illness Waiting Period - Essential (waiver except cataract/arthropathy for age 50+)
claim_process_summary: Cashless or reimbursement; planned cashless notice 2 days, emergency 48 hours, pre-auth TAT 1 hour. Reimbursement submit within 15 days. Penal interest 2% above bank rate for delays beyond 15 days.
